hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Identify the two forbidden adjacent characters in the input sequence.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Separate occurrences of the first character from the second character.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sort characters or interleave non-forbidden characters to break up forbidden transitions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def rearrangeToAvoidPair(s: str, forbidden: str) -> str:
    # Sort descending so characters like 'a' followed by 'b' are reversed to 'b' then 'a'
    chars = sorted(s, reverse=True)
    res = "".join(chars)
    if forbidden in res:
        # Sort ascending as fallback
        res = "".join(sorted(s))
    return res if forbidden not in res else ""
```

complexity.notes: Sorting characters eliminates forbidden adjacent transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive permutation checks take factorial time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Rearranges characters greedily to prevent forbidden pair adjacency.
